posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Just unlocked Captain Composite myself. Was in the Block, and the line-up/order was normal CC, Parse, Grampa Legs, PWAA and Tempest.

The first turn was pretty standard, though luck was on my side since AA quickly got out Supertonic and the harp with Subdominant not far behind, allowing multiple free powers and plays when teamed up with Gramps.  Now Gramps got out Lead From The Front pretty quick and took a decent beating(went down to 14), but after getting a Fortitude and Buckler or two was able to eat everything Infinitor could dish out. Parse and Tempest were on offence, taking down Manifestations and Infinitor's health bit by bit(along with keeping the enviro in check/clear), Gramps helping and healing with Motivational Charge where and when we could afford it. It took quite a while to finally draw Cataclysm(was in CC's last 10 cards of his deck), but with focused power usages and draws given to him by AA, it was soon in hand and used to do a 18-construct strike against a 2-hp Infinitor. He had milled his deck once and re-shuffled, revealing each Manifestation at least once, and CC had shown at least one of each of his Constructs. Not a single Construct had been destroyed all game, and no Manifestations were in play when we made the final blow.

I was quite lucky throuout this fight, but I'm not looking a gift horse in the mouth. :)

Edit: Added the tidbit about no Manifestations in play at end of game.
